modification_description: The synthesis should be expanded beyond collaborative structured limits and follow-through to explicitly require addressing the root causes of excessive gaming. Specifically: (1) identify whether gaming is serving as avoidance of stressful schoolwork and provide concrete academic support (tutoring, study plans); (2) use graduated changes and positive reinforcement (earning back gaming time through completed homework/sleep goals) rather than a single hard cap; and (3) include professional support if there are signs of gaming-related impairment such as persistent loss of control, severe sleep deprivation, or major mood changes. The framework should be 'function-restoration plus root-cause support,' not merely boundary-setting with consistent enforcement.
